{"id":1919120862,"question_id":4062,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 1 week","timestamp":1771082915,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"12 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1919120862/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"House Robber V","memory":"252.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    int n;\n    \n    ll bydp(vector<int>&nums , vector<int>&colors , int i , vector<ll>&dp)\n    {\n        //base case\n        if(i >= nums.size()) return 0;\n        if(dp[i] != -1) return dp[i];\n        \n        ll take = nums[i];\n        if(i+1 < n && colors[i] == colors[i+1])\n        {\n            take += bydp(nums , colors , i+2 , dp);\n        }\n        else take += bydp(nums , colors , i+1 , dp);\n\n        ll skip = 0 + bydp(nums , colors , i+1 , dp);\n        \n        return dp[i] = max(skip , take);\n    }\n    \n    long long rob(vector<int>& nums, vector<int>& colors) {\n        n = nums.size();\n        vector<ll>dp(n+1 , -1);\n        \n        return bydp(nums , colors , 0 ,dp);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"house-robber-v","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1709}
